svg.title: ArtViSiON — EXECUTiON: recce, fabrication, ACP cladding and installation
svg.desc: Flat vector scene in three zones: the recce — laser level, dimension marks, clipboard and the surveyor; the fabrication bench — saw cutting the letter blank, sparks, extractor; and the ACP cladding and installation — the bay grid, the panel sliding into place, the hoist, the fitters on the scaffold. Animated. Editable layers: background, artwork, logo.
